audit.whatIsWrong: Early advice said to trade 'when his Chomp is on cooldown'.
audit.why: Chomp is 3.5 seconds flat at every rank — there is no cooldown window to wait out, so that instruction produces a player standing still forever. The early game is about his base stats and the AD sap, not a timer.
audit.corrected: Level 1-2 text now gives the 3.5s figure and tells you to farm rather than wait for a gap that never comes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every all-in was gated on 'Subjugate on cooldown' with no number attached.
audit.why: Subjugate is 120/100/80 — at rank 1 that is a two-minute window you can genuinely plan around, and knowing that changes whether you force the level-6 fight or wait.
audit.corrected: Level 6 and first-item spikes now carry Subjugate at 120s rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Contaminate (W)' is not a Trundle ability, and the text claimed Twilight Shroud breaks his targeting for that zone.
audit.why: His W is Frozen Domain, a ground zone granting attack speed, move speed and increased healing while he stands on it. Twilight Shroud makes you unselectable, which fizzles targeted casts — Chomp at 300 range and Subjugate at 650 — but has no effect on ground-placed Frozen Domain or Pillar of Ice.
audit.corrected: Every 'Contaminate' replaced with Frozen Domain, and the shroud lines now separate targeted casts that fizzle from ground casts that still land. Matches the mirror at audits/top/trundle__akali.json.

edits.before: Trundle's only real window — his Chomp (Q) bites off a chunk of your AD and heals him, and his huge base stats bully you while you only have Q out and no Shroud to reset.
edits.after: Trundle's only real window — Chomp (Q) saps your Attack Damage and heals him every 3.5s, and his base stats bully you while you have only Q out and no Shroud to reset.

edits.before: Perfect Execution (R) is your kill button: E-flip onto him, cast-one dashes through, then cast-two from a fresh angle executes on his missing HP before Subjugate's heal can stabilize the brawl.
edits.after: Perfect Execution (R) is your kill button: E-flip onto him, cast-one dashes through, then cast-two from a fresh angle executes his missing HP before Subjugate — 120s at rank 1 — can stabilize the brawl.

edits.before: Lich Bane online — your hardest all-in. Catch him the instant he steps up to last-hit with Subjugate (R) on cooldown and burst him before he can drain back.
edits.after: Lich Bane online — your hardest all-in. Catch him the instant he steps up to last-hit with Subjugate (R) down, 120s at rank 1, and burst him before he can drain back.

edits.before: Drop Twilight Shroud (W) the moment he Chomps or steps into his Contaminate (W) zone — it breaks his targeting and lets you reset the trade out of his sustain
edits.after: Drop Twilight Shroud (W) as he Chomps — targeted casts like Chomp and Subjugate fizzle on you, but Frozen Domain and Pillar of Ice are ground casts and still land

edits.before: Drop Pillar of Ice (E) to wall off your E-dash escape and slow you, then ride his Contaminate (W) zone to stick in extended fights
edits.after: Drop Pillar of Ice (E) to wall off your E-dash and slow you, then fight on his Frozen Domain (W) where he heals and out-speeds you

edits.before: Trundle owns the first two levels: his Chomp (Q) bites a chunk of your AD off and heals him, and with only your Q out and no Shroud yet you cannot answer his base-stat bully. Do not walk up to auto — last-hit at the edge of your Q kunai range, eat a little Chomp poke, and bank energy. Watch his Pillar of Ice (E): he drops it to wall off your future E-dash and slow you, so keep that terrain in mind before you commit. Get to level 3 near full HP and the lane tips your way.
edits.after: Trundle owns the first two levels: his Chomp (Q) saps your Attack Damage and heals him on a 3.5s cooldown, so there is no gap to wait out, and with only Q and no Shroud you cannot answer his base-stat bully. Do not walk up to auto — last-hit at the edge of your Q kunai range, eat a little Chomp poke, and bank energy. Watch his Pillar of Ice (E): it is real terrain, so it walls off your E-dash and slows you. Get to level 3 near full HP and the lane tips your way.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 you take over: with all three basics your Assassin's Mark empowered autos and Q out-trade him, and Twilight Shroud (W) is the whole fight — drop it the instant he Chomps or rides his Contaminate (W) zone onto you, and his targeting and chase just die in the smoke. At 6 you get the kill button: E-flip in, R cast-one dashes through, then cast-two from a new angle to execute on his missing HP before Subjugate (R) heals and steals your resists. Only all-in when his Subjugate is on cooldown — it is the single thing that saves him.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 you take over: with all three basics your Assassin's Mark empowered attacks and Q out-trade him, and Twilight Shroud (W) is the whole fight — inside it his targeted Chomp and Subjugate simply cannot be cast, though Frozen Domain (W) and Pillar of Ice are ground casts that still land, so move as well as vanish. At 6 you get the kill button: E-flip in, R cast-one through, then cast-two from a new angle to execute his missing HP. Only all-in when Subjugate is down, 120s at rank 1 — it is the single thing that saves him.

edits.before: This is Trundle's revenge window. Once he has two items his Subjugate (R) steals a big slice of your resistances and percent-HP heals him through your entire combo, so your burst stops killing and his drain-tank brawl grinds you down. You cannot out-DPS a fed Trundle in an extended fight — his Contaminate (W) zone keeps him glued to you and his sustain eats your damage faster than you deal it. Convert the 6-to-first-item lead into towers and a closed game; if it runs long, only commit on him with your team and never solo-walk into his ult.
edits.after: This is Trundle's revenge window. Once he has two items his Subjugate (R) steals a big slice of your resistances and percent-HP heals him through your entire combo, so your burst stops killing and his drain-tank brawl grinds you down. You cannot out-DPS a fed Trundle in an extended fight — his Frozen Domain (W) gives him attack speed, move speed and boosted healing on the ground he chooses, so never fight on it. Convert the 6-to-first-item lead into towers and a closed game; if it runs long, only commit with your team.

edits.before: Shroud isn't up yet and your kit is still filling in — only trade when his Chomp is on cooldown, otherwise just farm at Q range.
edits.after: Shroud isn't up yet and your kit is still filling in — Chomp is a 3.5s cooldown, so there is no gap to wait for; just farm at Q range.

edits.before: Full basics online: your Assassin's Mark empowered autos and Q out-trade him, and Shroud blanks his Chomp-into-Contaminate chase.
edits.after: Full basics online: your empowered attacks and Q out-trade him, and Shroud fizzles his targeted Chomp — but Frozen Domain still heals him.

edits.before: You out-trade a pre-item Trundle — bait his Pillar and Contaminate zone, then reset the trade in Shroud so his sustain never catches up.
edits.after: You out-trade a pre-item Trundle — fight off his Frozen Domain and clear of Pillar of Ice, then reset in Shroud before his sustain catches up.

edits.before: Anti-heal him — shroud his bite, Q-poke. Akali wins the Subjugate cooldown windows.
edits.after: Anti-heal him — Shroud fizzles the targeted bite. Akali wins the Subjugate windows.

edits.before: Steals your stats. Avoid the brawl. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It steals your resists and it is 120s at rank 1. Engage once it is down.

notes: 'Contaminate (W)' is a fabricated ability — Trundle's W is Frozen Domain — and it appeared in wants.you[1], wants.foe[1], mid, late and whys[2]. Second correction: Twilight Shroud fizzles his targeted casts (Chomp 300, Subjugate 650) but does nothing about ground-placed Frozen Domain or Pillar of Ice, which the old text got backwards. The mirror at audits/top/trundle__akali.json also notes MC_WR_TABLES.trundle.akali (45.51) disagrees with the packet figure (48.43); that table is not writable so I made no edit.
